title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Who May Claim and How Many Claims a Cover Takes
content:
A claim under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` begins with written notice of loss. The notice names the container concerned and the loss suffered, and it can be lodged only by the claimant; nobody else, the desk included, lodges it on the claimant's behalf.

## Who counts as a claimant

A claimant must be a party the tier admits:

- the **cover holder**; or
- the **named consignee**, meaning the consignee printed on the transport document, where the tier admits named consignees. A consignee is recognised only when the company name registered on its customer record is exactly the same as the consignee name printed on the transport document.

| Tier | Cover holder may claim | Named consignee may claim | Most claims a cover takes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | yes | yes | 2 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | yes | yes | 2 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | yes | no | 2 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | yes | yes | 3 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | yes | yes | 3 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | yes | yes | 5 |

## How claims on a cover are counted

- The ceiling in the table counts the claim files on the cover over its whole life, leaving out any withdrawn claim and leaving out the claim now being handled.
- A cover never has more than one claim open at the same time.
- Notice of loss opens a claim on a cover whose status is active, or on a cover whose earlier claim has been closed, where the new notice concerns a further loss on the same shipment.

## Withdrawal

The claimant may withdraw a claim that is open. The cover then returns to active status, and the withdrawn claim does not count toward the ceiling.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- Under `AHL CargoCare Essential` a cover has one settled claim and one withdrawn claim on file. Only the settled claim counts, so the count stands at 1 against a ceiling of 2, and one more claim remains within the ceiling.
- Under the same tier a cover has two claim files, one rejected and one settled. The count stands at 2, which already equals the ceiling.
- A consignee whose registered name reads "Nordhavn Foods A/S" while the transport document prints "Nordhavn Foods" is not a recognised named consignee, because the names differ.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Essential` a named consignee is not admitted at all, whatever its name.
